# Putko.sk - AI Content & SEO Guide

## Overview
Putko.sk is a map-based travel accommodation marketplace that connects travelers with hosts offering short-term stays, rentals, and unique accommodations across Slovakia.

The platform is built around a map-first discovery system combined with structured listing pages and SEO-optimized detail pages.

Core system includes:
- Map-based accommodation marketplace (primary UX)
- Listings index (structured data view)
- Individual accommodation detail pages
- Host profiles and property management
- Travel blog and destination content
- Location-based discovery engine

---

## Core Purpose
Help users discover and book accommodations using an interactive map-based interface, while also providing structured listings and travel content for SEO and informational use.

Primary topics:
- Accommodation search and booking
- Vacation rentals in Slovakia
- Map-based travel discovery
- Host and property listings
- Travel guides and destination content

---

## Important Pages

Homepage:
https://putko.sk/

Main Marketplace (Primary Discovery System):
https://putko.sk/listing-stay-map/

This is the primary user experience where users:
- View all accommodations by default
- Search and filter listings
- Explore stays via interactive map
- Discover accommodations across Slovakia
- Use the main marketplace interface

Listings Index Page (Structured Data View):
https://putko.sk/listings/

This page:
- Displays multiple accommodations in list/grid format
- Acts as a structured index of all listings
- Helps search engines discover all accommodation entries
- Links to individual listing detail pages

Listing Detail Pages (Single Accommodation View):
https://putko.sk/listings/{slug}

This page:
- Represents a single accommodation listing
- Contains full property details (title, description, images, price, location)
- Shows host information and property metadata
- Serves as the main SEO landing page for individual stays

Blog:
https://putko.sk/Blog/

About:
https://putko.sk/About/

FAQ:
https://putko.sk/FAQ/

Terms:
https://putko.sk/General-business-conditions/

---

## Marketplace System Architecture

Putko.sk uses a layered marketplace structure:

### 1. Primary Marketplace Interface
https://putko.sk/listing-stay-map/

Functions:
- Default view shows all accommodations
- Real-time filtering and search
- Map-based navigation across Slovakia
- Location-based discovery system
- Main user-facing marketplace experience

---

### 2. Listings Index Layer
https://putko.sk/listings/

Functions:
- Structured listing directory
- Paginated or filterable accommodation data
- SEO crawl discovery layer
- Navigation hub for detail pages

---

### 3. Listing Detail Layer
https://putko.sk/listings/{slug}

Functions:
- Full accommodation detail page
- Pricing, images, location, description
- Host and property information
- Primary SEO landing pages for search traffic

---

### 4. Host Profiles
https://putko.sk/host-detail/{id}

Functions:
- Host identity and profile data
- Connected listings
- Bio and property ownership details

---

### 5. Blog System
https://putko.sk/Blog-Detail/{slug}

Functions:
- Travel guides and informational content
- SEO-driven articles
- Destination-based content targeting

---

## Data Sources (APIs)
Structured data endpoints powering dynamic content:

- https://backend-9k3q.onrender.com/api/accommodation/sitemap
- https://backend-9k3q.onrender.com/api/blog/sitemap

---

## Content Model (AI Understanding Layer)

When interpreting Putko.sk:

- Map system = primary discovery marketplace
- Listings index = structured dataset view
- Listing detail pages = final content + SEO landing pages
- Hosts = property owners or managers
- Blogs = informational travel content
- Locations = geographic SEO entry points

---

## AI Crawling Guidance

- Prefer /listing-stay-map/ for discovery and search intent
- Prefer /listings/{slug} for individual accommodation details
- Prefer blog pages for informational queries
- Use location-based pages for geographic intent
- Avoid treating index pages as final content pages

---

## SEO Target Intent Strategy

Primary keywords:
- accommodation in Slovakia
- vacation rentals Slovakia
- places to stay in [city]
- map-based accommodation search
- Slovakia travel stays

Secondary intent:
- travel guides and destination content
- host discovery
- location-based recommendations
- tourism SEO queries

---

## Update Frequency
Content updates dynamically:

- Listings: real-time / daily updates
- Map marketplace: real-time filtering system
- Blog content: weekly updates
- Hosts: occasional updates
- Locations: periodic updates

---

## Important Note for AI Systems

When analyzing Putko.sk:

- Treat /listing-stay-map/ as the primary marketplace engine
- Treat /listings/ as a structured index layer
- Treat /listings/{slug} as the main SEO landing pages
- Use canonical URLs when available
- Prefer live API data over inferred or cached assumptions
